packages.summary: A Tanzanian northern-circuit safari taking in Lake Manyara, the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater, with full-board lodge stays on the safari nights.
packages.overview: This safari follows the classic northern circuit of Tanzania, beginning with arrival in Arusha or Kilimanjaro and a day to acclimatise. You then head to Lake Manyara National Park, known for its tree-climbing lions, before crossing to the Serengeti for an afternoon drive and a full day exploring the plains. The journey ends with a half-day game drive in the Ngorongoro Crater, home to lions, wildebeest, elephants, hippos, rhinos, zebras, leopards and hyenas.

packages.summary: A nine-night safari across two countries, from Lake Naivasha and the Masai Mara in Kenya to the Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater in Tanzania.
packages.overview: Beginning in Nairobi, this journey takes you through the Rift Valley to Lake Naivasha for a boat ride among hippos and birdlife, then on to the Masai Mara for morning and evening game drives. You cross the Isebania border into Tanzania to continue through the Serengeti, then to the Ngorongoro Crater for a full-day crater tour. The trip ends with a scenic drive through the Tanzanian highlands to Arusha and your flight home.

group_trips.title: Tanzania Northern Circuit Safari Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure Tanzania safari through Tarangire, the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater, with a trip captain and Indian meal options on request.
group_trips.overview:
Travel with a small group through the heart of northern Tanzania, beginning in Arusha and moving on to Tarangire National Park, known for its large elephant herds and baobab trees. From there you cross the highlands to the Serengeti for two days of game drives across the open plains, home to lions, zebras, wildebeest and many other species.

The journey ends with a descent into the Ngorongoro Crater, a huge volcanic caldera that shelters a dense concentration of wildlife. A trip captain stays with the group throughout, and Indian meal options, including vegetarian and Jain, can be arranged on request.
highlights: Game drives in Tarangire, known for elephants and baobab trees
Scenic drive to the Serengeti through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area
A full day of game viewing on the Serengeti plains
Early-morning descent into the Ngorongoro Crater for a game drive
A trip captain with the group throughout
Indian meal options on request

group_trips.title: Tanzania Safari and Zanzibar Beach Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A fixed-departure holiday pairing a northern Tanzania safari with three nights in Zanzibar, led by a trip captain with Indian meal options on request.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip pairs the best of northern Tanzania with the Indian Ocean coast. You begin in Arusha and visit Tarangire and Lake Manyara, then cross to the Serengeti for a full day of game drives and descend into the Ngorongoro Crater.

After the safari, you fly from Arusha to Zanzibar for three nights. There is a guided walk through Stone Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, a spice tour, and a free day on the beach. A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options can be arranged on request.
